verdict.rationale: Veo has first-party Gemini API video-generation docs (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video) covering text/image-to-video and an Interactions API for multi-turn refinement. Community reports corroborate paid API and GCP-billed programmatic generation. However, the evidence never shows the job-submission and asset-retrieval flow (async operation, polling, download), and the docs carry a migration notice urging users to move to other models to avoid service interruptions. Missing for 10: documented job submit/poll/retrieve mechanics, an explicit asset download/storage path, and a stable non-deprecated API surface (no OpenAPI spec found).
